_doc: INSIGHT-1 (owner directive 2026-11-14): analytics are a feedback loop, not a report. Cookieless first-party hits (seed/analytics, served from Cloudflare) are the only analytics Ultrastable relies on: no opt-in gate, no third-party tag. foundation/insight.py reads each page's last 7 days against the 7 before, classifies it (rising, external_pull, fading), files at most max_actions_per_day growth items for what is rising or pulling outside readers, settles every finding settle_after_days later against what the page really got, and raises or lowers its own rise_min_views from the last settled findings. foundation/pm.py runs it inside the product manager pass. (ANALYTICS-LOOP-1); both use the same classes and the same settle and tune rules so a result in one is comparable with the other.
